structs.notes: Size 165352 (0x285E8) is proven by two allocation sites that also clear the whole object, and the last confirmed member (ammoMaximums at 165332) ends exactly there. IDA's 166488 is wrong (its tail cacheFixedForZone bool[1000] at 165328 and _pad289B8 extend past the allocation). Replay layout follows the game-test order only where Replay code confirms it: setForZone and cacheSetForZone are 1000-byte per-zone arrays, cacheFixedForZone and ammoMaximums follow. The ItemDef at 464 (stride 256) has maxStackSize at +252 by ResolveBrAmmoItem: *(this + (v8<<8) + 716) (outside my range, for the ItemDef owner). The scriptableDefMap hunk object of 9656 bytes is a separate fixed_map (not in my entry).
